title: Autoscaling
description: Add and remove replicas as load changes, between a minimum and a maximum you set. Scale up is quick, scale down is slow, and every decision is recorded with its reason.
loadError: Could not load this app's autoscaling.

empty.title: Autoscaling is off
empty.body: The app keeps the replica count you set by hand. Turn autoscaling on to follow load between a minimum and a maximum. Manual replica edits are refused while it is on.

next.no_capacity: No node has room for another replica. Add a node, free capacity, or lower the app's CPU and memory request. See the Placement card.
next.spend_cap: A spend cap is in force, so no replicas are added. Raise the budget or wait for the month to reset.
next.no_metrics: The metric is missing or stale, so the replica count is held. Check that the app is running and that its metrics are flowing.
next.max_replicas: Load wants more replicas than the maximum allows. Raise the maximum if the app should grow further.
next.global_ceiling: The operator's global replica ceiling is limiting this app. Raise APP_AUTOSCALE_MAX_REPLICAS on the control plane to allow more.
next.flapping: The count keeps changing direction. Widen the tolerances or lengthen the cooldowns under Advanced.

form.maxHelp: Never more than this. Capped by the operator's global ceiling.
form.metricCpuHelp: Average use as a percent of the app's CPU limit.
form.metricMemoryHelp: Average use as a percent of the app's memory limit.
form.metricRequestsHelp: Requests per second at the ingress, divided by replicas.
form.targetHelp: The value to hold the metric at. Replicas change only when it is clearly above or below this.
form.advancedHelp: Leave a field empty to use its default. Cooldowns and the stabilization window are in minutes.

error.replicas: Enter whole replica counts, with the maximum at least the minimum.
error.target: Enter a target above zero (up to 100 for CPU and memory).
error.advanced: Check the advanced fields: use whole numbers, and minutes of at least 1 second.

remove.title: Remove this policy?
remove.description: The app stops scaling on its own.

consequences.replicas: The replica count stays where it is now.
consequences.manual: You can set replicas by hand again.
consequences.history: The history of decisions is kept.

history.title: Recent decisions
history.empty: No decisions yet. Scale changes and the reasons for holding are listed here.
